# Coinley

> Coinley is a crypto payment gateway that helps businesses accept stablecoin payments (USDT, USDC) across 9+ blockchains — Ethereum, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Avalanche, BSC, Solana, and Monad. Non-custodial: merchants receive payments directly to their own wallets. 1% per transaction, no monthly fees.

Coinley is built for online stores, freelancers, creators, and global SMBs who want to accept crypto without blockchain knowledge. Customers pay via QR code, wallet connection, or direct transfer. Integration takes under 15 minutes via React/JS SDK, REST API, WooCommerce/Shopify plugin, or the Coinley MCP server for AI agents.

## Documentation

- [Overview](https://docs.coinley.io/): What Coinley does, the payment flow, and supported networks
- [SDK Integration](https://docs.coinley.io/#sdk-integration): React, Vanilla JS, and Next.js integration guides
- [API Integration](https://docs.coinley.io/#api-integration): Manual REST API integration
- [API Reference](https://docs.coinley.io/#api-reference): Endpoint specs — create, process, status, networks, webhooks
- [Webhooks](https://docs.coinley.io/#webhooks): Payment event callbacks and signature verification

## Products & Tools

- [Merchant Dashboard](https://merchant.coinley.io/): Sign up, manage payments, view analytics
- [Live Demo](https://littlestore.coinley.io/): Try a live Coinley-powered checkout
- [npm SDK (coinley-pay)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/coinley-pay): React and Vanilla JS SDK
- [WooCommerce Plugin](https://wordpress.org/plugins/coinley-payment-gateway/): Free WordPress/WooCommerce gateway plugin
- [MCP Server](https://github.com/coinleylabs/coinley-mcp): AI agent payment tools via Model Context Protocol
